title: Should You Buy Alphabet Stock Before the Huge Investor Update? | GOOG Stock Analysis
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA previews Alphabet ahead of its huge investor update on 28 Oct, which he will cover live for members. He owns the stock and reviews the last quarter reported 22 July: revenue up 24%, Google Services up 15% to $94.5 billion, Google Cloud up 82% to $24.8 billion, operating income up 30% at a 34% margin. He warns investors have become complacent about LLM disruption to Search, contrasts Alphabet hiring about 12,000 more staff year-on-year with Meta cutting 1%, and focuses on cash flow: operations generated $39 billion against $44.9 billion of capex, a negative free cash flow of about $5.9 billion, funded in part by roughly $90 billion of equity issuance he opposes. He urges Alphabet to sell its SpaceX stake, which he calls ridiculously overvalued, instead of diluting holders — that SpaceX comment is a passing opinion (SPCX — UNCERTAIN), not a call on SpaceX itself. Gemini processes 22 billion API tokens a minute with 950 million monthly users, across six other billion-user products. His updated DCF is $373 versus a $346 market price, forward P/E 22. Call made: GOOGL — CONDITIONAL_BUY at $346 stated (DCF $373), high conviction long term, but do not buy before the 28 Oct update — he sees more downside than upside into the print and advises holders who want to add to wait until after results.

calls.thesis: CONDITIONAL_BUY reiterated (most recent prior explicit was CONDITIONAL_BUY; no flip) — long-term buying opportunity at high conviction, but do NOT buy before the 28 Oct investor update: sees more downside than upside into the print, already owns it so is exposed to upside, and advises holders who want to add to wait until after results. DCF $373 vs $346 market (~8%, within margin of safety — fairly to slightly undervalued); forward P/E 22 on 24% revenue growth. Last quarter: revenue +24%, Google Services +15% to $94.5B, Cloud +82% to $24.8B, operating income +30% at 34% margin.
calls.bull_case: Cloud/AI growth keeps justifying capex — cash flow from operations rises ~30%+ again, Gemini (22B API tokens/min, 950M MAUs) scales across 6+ billion-user products.
calls.bear_case: Negative free cash flow widens (last quarter CFO $39B vs capex $44.9B, -$5.9B), more equity issuance on top of ~$90B already sold dilutes holders at undervalued prices, and LLM disruption hits Search while Alphabet keeps holding 'ridiculously overvalued' SpaceX equity.
